recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If maintainers refresh generated diagram artifacts later, nutritionproduct.svg may pick up the corrected manufacturer wording, but no FHIR source correction is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-48640 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested that NutritionProduct support human milk source capture by adding RelatedPerson as a reference choice for NutritionProduct.manufacturer, specifically Reference(Organization | RelatedPerson). The resolution also says NutritionProduct.instance.biologicalSourceEvent is intended to satisfy the requested traceability requirements, while more complex traceability and chain of custody are outside this recommendation.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in d0f9f0cb921ca73af9137792711cb1d73df8e5c1, which explicitly lists FHIR-48640 and changed source/nutritionproduct/structuredefinition-NutritionProduct.xml by adding RelatedPerson as a targetProfile for NutritionProduct.manufacturer, updating the manufacturer wording to include a person responsible for the product, and refining biologicalSourceEvent wording.
additional_context: NutritionProduct is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-46702 is the broader human milk ballot comment that spawned this traceability question, but its resolution delegated the RelatedPerson/manufacturer part to FHIR-48640 and boundary text to FHIR-46613/FHIR-46604. OO minutes for 2024-10-15 record the same FHIR-48640 vote and resolution. The checked-in nutritionproduct.svg still has older generated-looking manufacturer tooltip text, but the authoritative StructureDefinition is already correct and the SVG-only mismatch should not drive a semantic source edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active source already has NutritionProduct.manufacturer as Reference(Organization | RelatedPerson) and retains biologicalSourceEvent for the traceability mechanism described in the Jira resolution.
